_comment: Per-file line-count budgets (warren-4553). New files default to `threshold`. Listed files are grandfathered at their commit-time line count and may not grow beyond it. Refactor + lower budgets over time; ratchet only goes down. The three `src/ui/` entries are the grandfather baseline from warren-c8bd, which brought src/ui under this gate for the first time; every number is the measured line count at that commit, not a padded one. The walk-form entry was grandfathered by warren-a51e, which adopted the responsive.ts control/footer tokens in the dispatch-plan footer.
